subject: 连云港海清寺阿育王塔
caption: 海清寺 · 阿育王塔
八面九级砖塔 · 北宋天圣元年重建
source_note: 实照确认九级叠涩砖檐、低顶与高大首层；去除香炉、树木与题字，未添加失去的木构屋檐或想象的长塔刹。

Match its elegant delicate slightly organic thin black strokes, restrained detail, large white surfaces and quiet visual density. Image 2 is an actual photograph of the NAMED MONUMENT and is GEOMETRY ONLY.
Create sparse fine BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE, all surfaces and openings WHITE. Confident thin exterior contours and fewer finer interior structural lines. No solid black fills, no shadows, no gray shading, no hatching, no pencil grain, texture or gradients, no color. Simplify repetitive ornament; do not trace every brick, tile, rafter or weathered patch. Roof and wall surfaces should stay predominantly blank. Preserve the actual identifying geometry, proportions and present condition. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, fences, surrounding buildings and sky. No text, calligraphy, labels, captions, dimension marks, watermark or border. A few short ground strokes only.
Portrait 1024x1536, whole tower and base occupy about 82% of canvas height with margins, full apex and footings uncut; centered near-frontal with minimal perspective.
SUBJECT: Haiqing Temple Ashoka Pagoda (海清寺阿育王塔), Lianyungang, China, built in the Northern Song from 1023. Use the actual photograph to preserve this distinctive NINE-storey octagonal brick tower. Exactly NINE levels of masonry walls and NINE broad, tightly stepped corbelled-brick eave bands; the corbelling consists of close horizontal brick ledges, NOT timber pitched tile roofs. DO NOT add wooden balconies, sweeping tiled eaves, Chinese wooden roof curves or a long metal finial. Preserve the low pointed pale dome-like cap and thin needle on the top in the photo. Ground floor is tall and wide with one tall arched entrance and rectangular stone lintel frame; letters on the frame become blank. The storey above it has a deep brick bracket/platform band beneath a taller arched opening. Upper floors become steadily smaller with rounded arch openings, narrower vertical wall bands, and horizontal recessed rectangular decorative panels near the top. All NINE eave bands and the low top must be countable and uncut. Keep the strong solid octagonal mass and gentle taper, near frontal and full ground-level base. Remove the incense burner which masks the base, remove trees, stone plaques, railings and other surroundings. Render the corbelled band profiles with only a few parallel contour lines each, not scores of dense lines; blank walls with a few short selective brick marks. All windows and doorways are WHITE unfilled openings. No dense brick pattern. Nine layers, low simple cap, complete ground-floor base.

historical_sources.supports: 塔有唐代前身，宋天圣元年1023重建；九级八面；20世纪70年代维修发现石函、银棺、瓷瓶与舍利等物。

site_recommendation.name: 海清寺阿育王塔
site_recommendation.place: 江苏 · 连云港 · 花果山麓
site_recommendation.lede: 海清寺阿育王塔以九层叠涩砖檐向上收分，高大的首层塔室与层层券门形成清晰节奏。花果山脚下的砖塔保存着北宋时期的轮廓，外观简朴而挺拔。
facts: 塔有唐代前身，现塔按北宋天圣元年（1023）重建登记，不取唐代沿革为主体年代。
塔身八面九级，砖檐层层叠涩，券门与低矮塔顶构成现状轮廓。
20世纪70年代维修在塔心发现石函、银棺、瓷瓶与舍利等物，现由连云港市博物馆保存。

quality_check.notes: 九层檐带、高大首层、砖斗栱带与低顶完整，门洞留白；无香炉遮挡。
